ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surahs? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Surahs to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Selected Surahs has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surahs.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Surahs with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wudhu.
   B. Use Wudhu to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Wudhu with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Wudhu has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara Types of Najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. Say Twahara Types of Najasaat has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Twahara Types of Najasaat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara Types of Najasaat.
   D. Apply the teaching of Twahara Types of Najasaat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Fitness? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Fitness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Fitness.
   C. Use Hadith on Fitness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on Fitness has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Etiquette of Eating to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith on Etiquette of Eating has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Etiquette of Eating.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

8. Which response best shows understanding of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru? (1 mark)
   A. Use Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru.
   D. Apply the teaching of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pillars of Swalah has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Swalah.
   C. Use Pillars of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Attributes of Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Attributes of Allah has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Attributes of Allah.
   C. Apply the teaching of Attributes of Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Attributes of Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

12. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character.? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character..
   B. Say Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues: Kindness to Allah’s Creatures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic Manners of Dressing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Positive Usage of Media and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibition in Islam 02 5.3.1 Dua 02 6.0 Muamalat 6.1 Obligation of parents to c and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
